title: Before We Adapt: The Zero-Shot Generalization Bottleneck in Continual World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.41041v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continual reinforcement learning (CRL) requires agents to operate under environmental changes while reusing prior knowledge whenever possible. We argue that model-based reinforcement learning provides a promising framework for this setting because learned world models (WMs) can, in principle, support change detection, knowledge reuse, adaptation, and acquisition of new knowledge. However, such benefits depend heavily on whether the learned model can generalize beyond the contexts in which it was trained. In this work, we propose to formulate this problem with a contextual Markov decision process in which context is decomposed into behavioral and physical components. This view organizes continual WM learning into reuse, adaptation, and acquisition of new knowledge. As a first step, we study direct reuse when behavioral rules remain unchanged. translated_title: 在我们适应之前：持续世界模型中的零样本泛化瓶颈
translated_abstract: 持续强化学习（CRL）要求智能体在环境发生变化的情况下运行，并尽可能复用先验知识。我们认为，基于模型的强化学习为这一设定提供了一个有前景的框架，因为学习到的世界模型（WM）原则上可以支持变化检测、知识复用、适应以及新知识的获取。然而，这些收益在很大程度上取决于学习到的模型能否泛化到其训练时所处上下文之外。在这项工作中，我们提出用上下文马尔可夫决策过程（contextual MDP）来形式化该问题，并将上下文分解为行为组件和物理组件。这一视角将持续世界模型学习组织为复用、适应和新知识的获取三类情形。作为第一步，我们研究了行为规则保持不变时的直接复用情形。在受控的 FourRooms 任务中使用 Dyna-Q 和 TD-MPC 进行实验，我们发现零样本复用可能导致性能显著退化……
tldr: 该论文将上下文分解为行为与物理两部分，用上下文马尔可夫决策过程框架来组织持续世界模型学习中的复用、适应与新知识获取，并通过 FourRooms 任务上的实验揭示了一个关键发现：即使行为规则不变，零样本直接复用已学习的世界模型也会遭遇泛化瓶颈、导致性能退化。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes continual world model learning by decomposing context into behavioral and physical components within a contextual MDP framework, and reveals a zero-shot generalization bottleneck: even when behavioral rules remain unchanged, directly reusing learned world models can degrade agent performance.
